title: HE IS WITH YOU
IN EVERY FIRE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: glowing embers in ancient stone hearth
thick storm clouds with light breaking through
sunlight rays piercing through dark clouds

scenes.a: If the outcome of that restless situation is keeping you awake, stay here in stillness.
Lord, we bring every trembling thought into Your presence, asking that You steady the heart.
When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee:
when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
Grant us the quiet confidence that even in the most intense trials, Your protection remains absolute.
May every step we take today be guided by Your hand until we reach rest.
